messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — PR https://git.redwood.com/redwood/docs/pull/1423 has a cost/latency snippet that still uses the old SDK shape (python v0.2). It fails on our snippet-lint and confuses customers. Can someone take the rewrite + QA?

marco: I'm free to take it. Which snippet file? can you paste the snippet here?

elaine: Here — original snippet in the PR:
```
from redwood import SDKClient
client = SDKClient(api_key="${{REDWOOD_KEY}}")
resp = client.cost_breakdown(model="gpt-mini", prompt="...", return_latency=True)
print(resp)
```

elaine: Fails because SDKClient was renamed to Redwood and cost_breakdown was moved to observability.metrics.get_cost_latency.

docs-bot: CI check: snippet-lint failed (error: unknown function `cost_breakdown`) :x:

marco: ok. I'll replace with a minimal python example using v1.3 interface and add a note about sampling vs aggregated metrics.

priya: include both server-side (console dashboard REST) and SDK example? customers ask for both.

marco: good call. I'll add a tiny dashboard query snippet (console) and SDK call. Drafting now.

marco: DRAFT (python):
```
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="${{REDWOOD_KEY}}")
# fetch cost + p50 latency for a model over last 24h
metrics = client.observability.metrics.get_cost_latency(
    model="redwood/gpt-mini",
    start="24h",
    end="now",
    granularity="1h"
)
print(metrics.summary)
```

marco: DRAFT (js):
```js
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const metrics = await client.observability.metrics.getCostLatency({
  model: 'redwood/gpt-mini',
  start: '24h',
  end: 'now',
  granularity: '1h'
})
console.log(metrics.summary)
```

sam: looks good. Add note: for exact request-level latency use tracing.hooks.fetch_span -> but warn about sampling rate.

priya: Also mention that hosted API aggregations are delayed ~5m and deduped across retries.

marco: added both comments and a short migration note. pushing a commit to the PR now.

derek: quick ask — can you link the dashboard id customers see in Console? helps SRE when they triage.

marco: added console-dashboard link: https://console.redwood.com/org/acme/dashboards/metrics-uuid-1234 and a short code comment showing the dashboard query snippet.

elaine: awesome, @marco — can you also run the snippet-lint locally? CI picked another lint fail around triple backticks in the markdown.

marco: running `make snippet-lint` now.

docs-bot: snippet-lint: local pass ✅

marco: pushed commit 3c4b9f, updated PR description with migration note and added a changelog entry under docs/migrations/observability.md

elaine: thanks — I'll do a quick pass then merge after 1 approval. tagging @priya @sam for review :pray:

priya: reviewing now, small nit on wording.

sam: LGTM pending tiny comment.

elaine: merged. :tada: closing PR.

marco: nice. I'll follow up with a short blog blurb for the release notes on the console docs page.

elaine: perfect — thanks everyone :heart:
